subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should this exact rebased dependency bundle be approved after privileged-workflow and Codex runner review, or should the Codex action bump be split into a dedicated security review?
rationale: The patch itself is mechanical, but the updated actions execute with sensitive credentials or affect release and security automation; repository policy also requires direct Codex source inspection before accepting the Codex-related portion.

options.title: Approve the stable exact head
options.body: After all required checks complete, approve one stable SHA if upstream review confirms unchanged permissions, expected legacy workspace-write behavior, and acceptable runner changes.

options.title: Split the Codex action bump
options.body: Land the routine action refresh separately and review openai/codex-action with dedicated Codex runtime and runner-boundary evidence.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Keep the bundle unmerged until Dependabot access and repeated rebasing stop producing moving heads.

recommendation.title: Approve the stable exact head
recommendation.body: After all required checks complete, approve one stable SHA if upstream review confirms unchanged permissions, expected legacy workspace-write behavior, and acceptable runner changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history spans both release automation and the Codex-backed docs-agent workflow.
